confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Kuala Lumpur price levels, not live booking pages or current listings. Restaurant anchors are the most reliable; accommodation varies with season, neighborhood and platform, and beer and wine vary sharply by venue type. Cocktail and wine follow the local price relationship to beer (about 2.25x and 2.5x the beer serving) because direct knowledge is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional Southeast Asia basis: benchmarked against large SEA tourism capitals with similar food and hotel price levels, priced below Singapore. Alcohol is set higher than in neighboring Thailand to reflect Malaysia's alcohol duties.
